Summary

Analysis of ASH1/CLB1, SUN4, SRL1, mRNAs by smFISH including bud segmentation.

This is a first attempt at analysis in R started by EW on 8 July 2026.

Load bud segmentation data

# make short table here of strain ids and names in desired order
strain_table <-
  tribble(~strain, ~condition, ~strain_nice,
    "YET915", "WT",    "WT",
    "YET916", "ΔSSD1", "ssd1Δ",
    "YET919", "ΔMPT5", "mpt5∆",
    "YET563", "ΔSHE2", "she2∆",
    "YET572", "ΔSHE3", "she3∆",
    "YET918", "ΔSUN4", "sun4∆",
    "YET921", "ΔSEC72","sec72∆"
    ) %>%
  mutate(strain_nice = as_factor(strain_nice))

strain_table

mrna_names <- c("ASH1CLB2", "SRL1", "SUN4")

mrna_names
## [1] "ASH1CLB2" "SRL1"     "SUN4"
scale_colour_mrna <- function(...) {
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("ASH1CLB2" = "magenta3", 
               "SRL1" = "goldenrod3", 
               "SUN4" = "forestgreen"),
    ...)
}
mrna_alldata <- here::here("data", "Mara_budSegmentationData20260311.csv") %>%
  read_csv() %>%
  select(!starts_with("Unnamed") ) %>%
  select(!"condition + strain") %>%
  rename(cell_id = "...1") %>%
  mutate(replicate = as_factor(replicate)) %>%
  rename_with(str_replace_all, pattern = "-", replacement = "_") %>%
  left_join(strain_table, by = c("strain", "condition"))

Overview plots across strains

mRNAs per cell

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA, y = total_RNAs),
               outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

mRNAs per mother

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata, aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_mother),
               outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

mRNAs per bud, filtering only for budded cells

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0), 
       aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud),
               outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_colour_mrna()

Proportion in bud, filtering only for budded cells

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0),
       aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs),
               outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_colour_mrna()
## Warning: Removed 780 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_boxplot()`).

Proportion in bud, across biological replicates, for most relevant strains

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0,
                strain_nice %in% c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆")),
       aes(x = strain_nice, colour = mRNA)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs, 
                   group = interaction(strain_nice, replicate)),
               outlier.size = 0.5,
               position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA,
             ncol = 1) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_colour_mrna()
## Warning: Removed 252 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_boxplot()`).

Count vs total cell area for WT

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area > 1000,
                strain_nice %in% c("WT")),
       aes(x = area, y = total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = replicate, colour = mRNA),
              method = "loess", se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  # coord_cartesian(expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_colour_mrna()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

# + 
#   theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
#   scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
#   scale_colour_mrna()
ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(strain_nice %in% c("WT", "ssd1Δ", "mpt5∆", "she2∆", "she3∆"),
                area_bud > 0),
       aes(x = area, y = total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = mRNA),
              method = "gam",  se = FALSE) + 
  facet_grid(mRNA ~ strain_nice, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1500,6500), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_mrna()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")'

Distribution of cell area by strain

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata,
       aes(x = area)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1,
              kernel = "rectangular") + 
  geom_density(aes(linetype = replicate),
               colour = "grey50",
              kernel = "rectangular") + 
  facet_wrap(~ strain_nice,
             ncol = 1,
        strip.position = "left") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1500,6500), expand = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))

Distribution of bud area by strain

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(area_bud > 0),
       aes(x = area_bud)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1,
              kernel = "rectangular") + 
  geom_density(aes(linetype = replicate),
               colour = "grey50",
              kernel = "rectangular") + 
  facet_wrap(~ strain_nice,
             ncol = 1,
        strip.position = "left") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,3000), expand = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))

Prop in bud vs bud size for WT

ggplot(data = mrna_alldata %>%
         filter(strain_nice %in% c("WT"),
                area_bud > 0),
       aes(x = area_bud, y = total_RNAs_bud / total_RNAs)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = replicate, colour = mRNA),
              method = "loess", se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ mRNA, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,3000), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_colour_mrna()
